QuestInfo.name: Violetta's Knight
QuestInfo.0: Talk to the Mushking, he wants to thank you for saving Princess Violetta and the Mushking Empire.
QuestInfo.1: The Mushking wishes to reward you for saving Princess Violetta and the Mushking Empire. He says Violetta will handle the reward personally. Gulp.
QuestInfo.2: You got the <#t1142718#> title for saving the Mushking Empire and Princess Violetta. She says many people will be jealous of being her knight. Suuuuuuure.

0.0: Your work cannot be described in words! You not only saved our Mushking Empire, you saved my Violetta! Please, take this reward.

yes.0: Violetta shall grant you your reward herself. Talk to her.

no.0: Don't be so humble. Every mushroom in the kingdom is praising your honorable deeds.

yes.0: Now that you have the title of my knight, many people will be jealous of you. But that is the fate of anyone involved with me... I wish you the best.

npc.0: Why are you being so shy? Violetta is waiting for you.

1.0: My hero! If it weren't for you, the Mushking Empire would have surely fallen. I would like to present you this title, #r<#t1142718#>#k, and #ra an assortment of gifts#k, along with my eternal gratitude.
